name: Cross-Asset Carry ex-Commodities
description: Carry tilt ranked across equity and bond assets only, excluding commodities and precious metals. Equal-weights the top_n high-carry assets from the equity sleeve (VUSA, EQQQ, IWRD, IMEU, IIND) and bond assets (VUTY). Focuses on the carry premium where ETF yield proxies are most reliable (bonds + equities).
